releaseNotes:
Bookings
- Email inquiry saves now show confirmation and retain saved dates. Editing requires an explicit action, preventing accidental repeat saves.
- Current and upcoming stays show guests only, collapse when unused, and load 50 bookings at a time with search and Show more.

Guest Inbox
- Standard availability and unavailable reply snippets now support the same rich formatting tools as emails.
- Formatted snippets preserve typed reply text and replace the standard signature.
